==Description==
'''Coffin''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Halloween 2020 Event#Halloween Season Pass|Halloween Season]]. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 3 of the Event Season Pass, which would cost 225 Candies or {{Robux|60}}. The total cost to get from Rank 1 to Rank 3 was 475 Candies or {{Robux|150}}.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] is based on the meme [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j9V78UbdzWI&ab_channel=DigiNeko Coffin Dance], although the posture of the emote is slightly different.
*The walking animation for this emote is the same as your own animation pack.
**It is possible to use standard Roblox emotes (such as "/e dance") while using the '''Coffin''' emote.
